methodology: A national card scheme defines scheme rules and governance for cards used primarily in one country. Card processors, switches, clearing systems and acquirers are recorded separately and never converted into national-card merchant offers without an official merchant tariff.

active_national_card_schemes.name: Karanta
active_national_card_schemes.note: Activa remains a Slovenian card product/brand, often co-badged with an international scheme. The current ECB national-scheme count and Banka Slovenije statistics identify Karanta as the relevant domestic credit-card scheme.

active_national_card_schemes.name: BankAxept
active_national_card_schemes.note: Norway is outside the EU count of nine schemes. BankAxept publishes a scheme charge, but merchants also need a separate acquiring agreement with a bank; the scheme charge is therefore not a complete acquiring offer.

active_national_card_schemes.name: PostFinance Card
active_national_card_schemes.note: Switzerland is outside the EU count of nine schemes.

switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.name: PSA Payment Services Austria
switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.reason_not_national_card_scheme: PSA provides issuing support and processing for international card products and operates account-payment infrastructure; it is not a separate merchant card scheme.

switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.name: JCC Cards Payment System
switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.reason_not_national_card_scheme: JCC acquires, processes, clears and settles cards issued under international scheme licences; the submitted name ICC appears to be a typo for JCC.

switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.name: STMP / SNCE
switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.reason_not_national_card_scheme: STMP clears mainly Visa and Mastercard transactions and SNCE settles them. ECB explicitly reclassified STMP as a clearing system; Spain has no current national card scheme.

switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.name: DIAS
switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.reason_not_national_card_scheme: DIAS is Greece's national automated clearing house and operates IRIS/account-payment services; it is not a card scheme.

switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.name: Krajowy System Rozliczeń (KSR)
switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.reason_not_national_card_scheme: KSR, operated by Fiserv Polska, clears domestic card transactions and exchanges data between issuers and acquirers; it does not define a separate card brand.

switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.name: Inkart
switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.reason_not_national_card_scheme: The Inkart payment system ceased operation on 30 June 2019.

switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.name: ROMCARD
switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.reason_not_national_card_scheme: ROMCARD provides processing, switching, clearing and 3-D Secure services for international schemes; it is not a Romanian card brand.

switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.name: Activa / Bankart
switches_processors_and_legacy_systems.reason_not_national_card_scheme: Bankart is a processor. Activa is retained as a local product/brand but is not counted as an additional current national scheme alongside Karanta.
